source: Visit Syracuse holiday guide and organizers' sites (Nov 2026)

guides.title: Christmas lights
guides.intro: The best holiday light displays in and around Syracuse this season, with dates, hours and prices checked against each organizer.

items.name: Lights on the Lake
items.blurb: Central New York's two-mile drive-through light show, now in its 37th season. Car passes are sold online in advance by date and are limited.
items.blurbEs: El recorrido en auto de luces de dos millas, en su temporada 37. Los pases se compran en línea por fecha y son limitados.

items.name: Holiday Nights at the Zoo
items.blurb: The zoo after dark with holiday lights. Advance prices; kids 2 and under are free.
items.blurbEs: El zoológico de noche con luces navideñas. Precios por adelantado; menores de 2 años gratis.

items.name: Clinton Square tree and ice rink
items.dates: Tree lit Nov 27; rink open through the season
items.addr: W Genesee St & S Salina St, Syracuse, NY 13202
items.blurb: Downtown's 42-foot tree over the outdoor skating rink. Seeing the lights is free; skating and rentals cost extra.
items.blurbEs: El árbol de 13 metros del centro junto a la pista de patinaje. Ver las luces es gratis; patinar cuesta aparte.

items.name: Holidays at Lorenzo
items.blurb: A free walk-through light display on the grounds of an 1807 mansion, with decorated-house tours ($6, $2 for ages 12 and under).
items.blurbEs: Un recorrido de luces gratis en los jardines de una mansión de 1807, con visitas a la casa decorada ($6; $2 menores de 12).

guides.title: Holiday markets
guides.intro: Where to shop local for the holidays around Syracuse: village Christmas fairs, farm markets and festival trees.

items.name: Dickens Christmas in Skaneateles
items.dates: Fri Nov 27, then Sat & Sun through Dec 20, 12–4 PM; also Dec 24, 12–2:30 PM
items.blurb: Costumed Dickens characters stroll the lakeside village while the shops stay open for holiday browsing.
items.blurbEs: Personajes de Dickens recorren el pueblo junto al lago mientras las tiendas abren para compras navideñas.

items.name: Festival of Trees and Light
items.blurb: Decorated trees fill the Everson, with trees, wreaths and seasonal pieces for sale.
items.blurbEs: Árboles decorados llenan el Everson, con árboles, coronas y artículos de temporada a la venta.

items.name: Christmas at Abbott Farms
items.dates: Weekends in December; Christmas Bazaar Dec 5
items.blurb: A family farm's December weekends: a Christmas bazaar on Dec 5, a carnival Dec 12 and breakfast with Santa Dec 19.
items.blurbEs: Fines de semana de diciembre en una granja familiar: bazar navideño el 5, carnaval el 12 y desayuno con Santa el 19.

items.name: Ted & Amy's 93Q Christmas Spectacular
items.blurb: Free holiday morning at the mall with arts and crafts and ornament making for kids.
items.blurbEs: Mañana navideña gratis en el centro comercial con manualidades y adornos para niños.
